selection.rule: Use the registered written-founder chain with open communication and E-open rewriting at the finer numerical resolution; show all three cells and all retained phases of that chain, if the raw archive is available.
selection.display: Preserve actual cell identities, saved sample times, phase boundaries and handovers. Do not connect trajectories across replacement as though one cell persists. Cue periods, teacher removal, isolated retention and classification thresholds must be identified.

clock.units: model time units; initial 1000-unit stock preparation excluded

display: All saved samples for all three target/pupil cells in each panel; actual IDs retained. Lines join samples within a cell, never different cells across replacement.
scope: Static selected-chain extraction and integrity checks, not a rerun of the complete independent campaign audit or a new success-rate analysis.
